starting_cell_type: Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells (iPSCs) or Dermal Fibroblasts
approach: Direct Lineage Reprogramming vs. Directed Floor Plate Differentiation

transcription_factors.role: Nuclear receptor essential for midbrain DA neuron development
LIM homeodomain factor specifying floor plate identity
Substantia nigra compacta DA survival and specification

reprogramming_cocktails.cocktail_name: Non-Integrative Floor Plate Direct Differentiation (Kriks/Studer Protocol)
reprogramming_cocktails.delivery_method: Recombinant Small Molecules + Growth Factors (Dual SMAD + WNT activation)
reprogramming_cocktails.teratoma_risk: Extremely Low (residual pluripotency purged via magnetic cell sorting for NCAM/CORIN)
reprogramming_cocktails.notes: Gold standard for Parkinson's cell therapy trials (e.g., STEM-PD, BlueRock MSK-DA01).

reprogramming_cocktails.oncogene_reactivation: Insertional mutagenesis risk at random integration sites
reprogramming_cocktails.notes: Requires viral vector copy number monitoring; potential disruption of host tumor suppressor loci.

reprogramming_cocktails.cocktail_name: Classical 4-Factor iPSC Derivation (Yamanaka Factors) followed by differentiation
reprogramming_cocktails.teratoma_risk: High if undifferentiated iPSCs persist in graft
reprogramming_cocktails.oncogene_reactivation: High - c-MYC retroviral reactivation triggers secondary malignancies in animal models
reprogramming_cocktails.notes: Historical protocol; prohibited in modern human clinical trial candidates without replacement of c-Myc.

differentiation_timeline.critical_qc: Electrophysiological action potential and dopamine release assays

key_references.title: Dopamine neurons derived from human ES cells efficiently engraft in animal models of Parkinson's disease
Preclinical assessment of human embryonic stem cell-derived dopaminergic progenitors

reprogramming_cocktails.cocktail_name: GiWi Protocol (GSK3 inhibitor followed by Wnt inhibitor)
reprogramming_cocktails.delivery_method: Chemically Defined Media (CHIR99021 Day 0 -> IWR-1/IWP-2 Day 3)
reprogramming_cocktails.teratoma_risk: Extremely Low when followed by Glucose Deprivation / Lactate selection
reprogramming_cocktails.notes: Produces >90% purity cTnT+ beating cardiomyocytes; lactate purification kills non-cardiomyocytes.

key_references.title: Chemically defined generation of human cardiomyocytes
Human ES-cell-derived cardiomyocytes regenerate non-human primate heart

approach: Stage-wise Embryonic Recapitulation (Definitive Endoderm -> Pancreatic Endoderm -> Beta Cell)

transcription_factors.role: Mature beta-cell identity and insulin secretion

reprogramming_cocktails.cocktail_name: Seven-Stage Chemically Defined Endoderm Differentiation (Melton/Pagliuca Protocol)
reprogramming_cocktails.delivery_method: Growth factor sequence (Activin A -> FGF10 -> Retinoic Acid -> ALK5i)
reprogramming_cocktails.teratoma_risk: Very Low (mitigated by CD142 / GP2 enrichment)
reprogramming_cocktails.notes: Yields SC-islets that reverse hyperglycemia in diabetic rodents and entered phase 1/2 human trials (Vertex VX-880).

differentiation_timeline.critical_qc: Static Glucose Stimulated Insulin Secretion (GSIS) stimulation index >2.0

key_references.title: Generation of functional human pancreatic beta cells in vitro
Stem cell-derived islets in clinical trials for type 1 diabetes
